findings.description: The scoring pipeline incorrectly computes the PHQ-9 self-harm flag (phq9_self_harm_flag) using item 8 (phq9_8) instead of item 9 (phq9_9). Item 9 is the specific question addressing thoughts of self-harm/suicide as specified in the PHQ-9 scoring guide.
findings.evidence: 124 mismatches out of 505 rows when compared against question 9. 100% exact match when compared against question 8 (phq9_8).
